userStories.title: Activity store
userStories.description: As a developer, I need persistent storage of voice sessions and posted reports so that tracking survives restarts.
acceptanceCriteria: `activity/store.py` defines the `ActivityStore` Protocol and `SqliteActivityStore(path)` implementing it, following `cs2/store.py` (`_SCHEMA` tuple of `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, lazy `_connect` creating the parent dir, blocking calls via `asyncio.to_thread`, `closing(...)` per call)
Table `voice_sessions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id, channel_id, start_ts REAL, end_ts REAL NULL, last_seen REAL)` plus an index on `(user_id, start_ts)`; an open session has `end_ts` NULL
Table `reports_posted(month_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, posted_at REAL)`

Protocol methods: `open_session(user_id, channel_id, now)`, `close_session(user_id, now)` (closes that user's open session; no-op if none), `heartbeat(now)` (sets `last_seen` on all open sessions), `close_stale(default_end: float | None)` (closes every open session at its `last_seen`), `open_sessions() -> list[Session]`, `sessions_between(start_ts, end_ts) -> list[Session]` (any session overlapping the window, open ones included), `known_users() -> set[int]` (every user ever seen), `mark_report_posted(month_key, now)`, `report_posted(month_key) -> bool`
A user never has two open sessions: `open_session` closes any existing open session for that user at `now` first, in the same transaction

Tests with `tmp_path` real SQLite: Protocol conformance, round trip, persistence across a new instance, missing parent dir, overlap query (inside, spanning start, spanning end, outside, open), `close_stale` uses `last_seen`, `asyncio.to_thread` recorder test like `tests/test_cs2_store.py`
Docs: `README.md` "Data and storage" (new `activity.sqlite3` and table purposes; fix the sentence "The only persistent data is the CS2 database"), backup notes in `docs/deployment.md`
Typecheck passes
`./scripts/check.sh` passes

userStories.title: Monthly auto-post
userStories.description: As a member, I want the previous month's overview posted automatically at the start of each month, exactly once.
acceptanceCriteria: `activity/reporter.py` (no `discord` import): `MonthlyReporter(store, tz, clock)` with `due_month() -> Month | None` returning the previous month when it has not been posted (`reports_posted` says no) and the month has ended in `ACTIVITY_TIMEZONE`; at most one month per call, oldest unposted first, never older than the first recorded session's month, and never a month with no data

`confirm(month)` marks the month posted; called after each send attempt (also on failure that cannot be retried, e.g. missing permissions logged once), so a broken channel cannot spam retries every hour

An hourly `tasks.loop` in the cog runs one cycle: `due_month` → build report → post → `confirm`. It never raises (`try/except Exception: log.exception`), `before_loop` waits for ready, and it only starts when `ACTIVITY_CHANNEL_ID` is set

The channel is resolved like `cogs/cs2.py` (`get_channel`, then `fetch_channel`; `NotFound`/`Forbidden` → missing) and checked with `cs2/channels.py` `channel_problem` / `is_post_channel`; the cog logs its own warning text (once per cause), not the CS2 text

userStories.title: Toasty message capture and parser
userStories.description: As a member, I want my `;pokemon` commands with Toasty recorded so that catches show up in the stats.
acceptanceCriteria: `tests/fixtures/toasty/replies.json` holds the cases from `replies.md` as structured fixtures (`name`, `invoker_content`, `reply_content`, `reply_embeds`, `expected`) and keeps `replies.md` as the original source; there are separate fixtures for a plain catch, an `an` article, a trailing-junk catch, a shiny catch with everything in `content`, the same shiny catch with the text in an embed `description`, a cooldown, and a non-Toasty reply. Every fixture marked `"assumed": true` is a variation of a real reply, not an observed one

`activity/pokemon.py` (no `discord` import): `is_pokemon_command(content: str) -> bool` (case-insensitive `;pokemon`, an optional space after `;`, nothing else on the line; `;pokemon list` is not a command) and `parse_reply(content: str, embeds: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> Catch | Cooldown | None`

`parse_reply` searches the content plus every embed's `title`, `description` and field values; `Catch(pokemon: str, shiny: bool)` for `you've caught an? (Shiny )?<Name>!` (the name may contain spaces, `-`, `.`, `'`, `:`, `♀`, `♂`; the leading `Shiny ` is stripped from `pokemon` and sets `shiny`); `Cooldown(wait_seconds: int | None)` for `You need to wait ... before catching another Pokemon` (parse `1h 50m 16s` style durations, `None` when unparseable); `None` for anything else. The mention in the text is ignored (the user is the author of the replied-to message)

New table `pokemon_events(message_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, user_id, ts REAL, kind TEXT, pokemon TEXT NULL, shiny INTEGER)` where `kind` is `catch` or `cooldown`; store methods `record_pokemon_event` (duplicates by `message_id` ignored) and `pokemon_events_between(start_ts, end_ts)`; known users from events are added to `known_users()` so the shame list includes them

Cog `on_message` (only registered when `TOASTY_BOT_ID` is set): a message from a human that satisfies `is_pokemon_command` is remembered in a small TTL dict (id -> author id; capped size, entries expire after 5 minutes). A message authored by `TOASTY_BOT_ID` whose `reference.message_id` is in the dict is parsed and recorded for the original author. `on_message_edit` re-parses an edited Toasty reply the same way (recording stays idempotent)

Nothing is recorded when `TOASTY_BOT_ID` is unset, for bot-authored commands, for unrelated Toasty messages, or for replies whose referenced message is unknown; raw message text is never stored, only the parsed fields

Tests: `is_pokemon_command` table (valid, `; pokemon`, upper case, with extra text, other prefix), parser against every fixture, pairing logic (reply to remembered message, reply to unknown message, other bot, TTL expiry, duplicate delivery, edit), the cog with fakes

Docs: `README.md` (Toasty section: what is tracked, Message Content intent requirement, known limitation: only works while the bot is online and only sees catches replied to `;pokemon`), `docs/deployment.md` (enable the intent in the Developer Portal when `TOASTY_BOT_ID` is set), `docs/manual-checks.md` (`;pokemon` end to end: catch, shiny, cooldown), `CLAUDE.md` Architecture if a module was added
Typecheck passes
`./scripts/check.sh` passes
